spots.name: Incheon Bridge
spots.summary: The Incheon Bridge is a reinforced concrete cable-stayed bridge in South Korea. At its opening in October 2009, it became the second bridge connection between Yeongjong Island and the mainland of Incheon. The Incheon Bridge is South Korea's longest spanning cable-stayed bridge.

spots.name: Dapdong Cathedral

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: St. Paul's Cathedral, also known as Incheon Cathedral and Dapdong Cathedral, is a Roman Catholic cathedral located in Incheon, South Korea's third largest city.

spots.name: Jayu Park
spots.summary: Jayu Park, also known as Freedom Park, is an urban park located in Incheon, South Korea. Established in 1888, it is the first Western-style park of Korea.

spots.name: Gonghwachun

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Gonghwachun was a historic restaurant specializing in Korean Chinese cuisine in Incheon Chinatown, South Korea. It first opened some time between 1905 and 1908, and is considered the first restaurant to serve the dish jajangmyeon in Korea. It closed in 1983.

spots.name: Incheon Asiad Main Stadium
spots.summary: The Incheon Stadium, commonly known as the Incheon Asiad Main Stadium (Korean: 인천아시아드주경기장), is a stadium located in Incheon, South Korea. Completed in July 2014, it is used mostly for athletics and was the main venue of the 2014 Asian Games.

spots.name: Jajangmyeon Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Jajangmyeon Museum is a food museum in Jemulpo District, Incheon, South Korea. It focuses on the history of the Korean Chinese cuisine dish jajangmyeon.

spots.name: Incheon Munhak Stadium
spots.summary: The Incheon Munhak Stadium is a sports complex in Incheon, South Korea and includes a multi-purpose stadium, a baseball park, and other sports facilities.

spots.name: Incheon Football Stadium
spots.summary: Incheon Football Stadium, a.k.a. the Sungui Arena Park, is a football-specific stadium in Incheon, South Korea, and is the home ground of Incheon United of the K League. The stadium was designed with a capacity of 20,891 spectators. It replaced the much larger Incheon Munhak Stadium.

spots.name: Incheon SSG Landers Field
spots.summary: The Incheon SSG Landers Field is a baseball stadium located in Incheon, South Korea. Formerly named the Munhak Baseball Stadium, it is the home of the KBO League team SSG Landers. The stadium has been remodeled with Shinsegae affiliate brands, including Starbucks, No Brand Burger, and the convenience store e-mart 24.

spots.name: Former Nippon Yusen's Incheon branch office
spots.summary: It is a multicultural art space. It is used as a creative studio, studio, exhibition hall, and performance hall. It is carrying out various cultural events and creative support projects for writers.

spots.name: Incheon Metropolitan City Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: It is a cultural complex that collects, preserves and exhibits cultural heritages in the Incheon area, and citizens learn and enjoy together.

spots.name: Memorial Hall for Incheon Landing Operation
spots.summary: Museum about the landing of 70,000 troops led by General MacArthur in 1950 during the Korean War. The museum has some landing craft and missiles from the war, and a memorial statue.

spots.name: Asiad Central Park
spots.summary: The 17th Asian Games were held in Incheon Metropolitan City from September 19 to October 4, 2014. 36 events were held. It is a plaza to celebrate this. The night view park and the ecological park are pretty. There is a nearby hotel, and it is easy to move around because it is in the center of Incheon.

spots.name: Liberty Park
spots.summary: Liberty Park is next to Chinatown. It is the first modern park in Korea. For most Incheon citizens, the park is well known for General MacArthur's statue and the memorial of the Centennial Anniversary of U.S.-South Korean relations. If you go to Liberty Park in April, you can see the full bloom of cherry blossoms. This place is a resting place for citizens who can see Incheon's downtown area, the

spots.name: Wolmido Island
spots.summary: Wolmido Island is a lively waterfront destination in Incheon, known for its seaside boardwalk, amusement parks, and fresh seafood restaurants. Visitors can enjoy scenic walks, thrilling rides at Wolmi Theme Park, and panoramic views of the city and ocean from Mount Wolmi. The island is easily accessible from downtown Incheon and offers a relaxing escape with cultural attractions, cruises, and vibr

spots.name: Wolmido
spots.summary: Wolmido was a major harbor in Incheon until Yeonan Budu was developed. However, visitors can still do many things in Wolmido. There is a small park, surrounded by a nature walk road. There are also many seafood restaurants and cafes with a great ocean view. What is more, a small harbor that can bring visitors to several islands is still operating. The Chinatown is just a few minutes away, so touri

spots.name: Songdo International City

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: This is a multi-billion-dollar planned city in the Incheon Free Economic Zone has office and residential towers, shops, and hotels. Central Park has a gorgeous lake with boat rides, and deer.

spots.name: Incheon Grand Park
spots.summary: A large park in the eastern inland area of Incheon. It has various facilities including a children's zoo, a botanical garden, an arboretum, a sledding area, etc. There are so many cherry blossom trees that the scenery is very nice during the cherry blossom season. As it is surrounded by Mt. Gwanmosan and Mt. Sanga, the hiking course is included inside the park. It is 160 meters tall and 150 meters

spots.name: Yeonan Pier (연안부두)
spots.summary: The terminal is the gateway to more than 100 islands in the West Sea, offering ferries to destinations like Palmi-do, Deokjeok-do, and even China. It features the bustling Incheon Fish Market, famous for affordable fresh seafood, as well as waterside parks, boat tours, and the St. Petersburg Square, which commemorates friendship with Russia. Visitors can enjoy authentic local cuisine, coastal walk

spots.name: Incheon government office building
spots.summary: It was the first to be declared a tangible cultural property in Incheon. The buildings across the street from Munhak Stadium are reproductions, not tangible cultural properties.

spots.name: Baekya Guwol (The White Night)
spots.summary: A popular and clean culinary pub (Yori-jujeom) in the Guwol-dong area, specializing in high-quality Korean cuisine and a wide variety of traditional Korean liquors (Jeongjong, Makgeolli, etc.). Highly recommended dishes include Hanwoo (Korean beef) sets, such as the Yukhoe Samhap (beef tartare platter) and savory stews. It is an excellent spot for experiencing a modern, elevated Korean drinking cu

spots.name: Cheongsil Hongsil

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Famous for dumplings and buckwheat noodles (soba), Cheongsil Hongshil started out in 1979. And in 1983, the current head office - the store in front of the Rotary Outdoor Stage in Sinpo-dong - was put on a signboard for Clean Room. There are branch stores in Sinpo-dong, Juan, Bupyeong, Yeonsu, and Nonhyeon. Some say the house is 'the most visited restaurant in Incheon.' Cooking and serving speed i

spots.name: Gyeongin Myeonok
spots.summary: Incheon's Pyeongyang naengmyeon opened in 1883. People from all over Paldo gathered in Incheon in the hope of "Incheon Dream," and Pyeongan-do people opened a restaurant in Incheon and made and sold Pyeongyang naengmyeon. Unlike the history of the tile-roofed house, the building is now on the first and second floors of the modern building, but you can read more than half a century of history from

spots.name: Jeongdeun Dakbal
spots.summary: Jeongdeun Dakbal is a popular casual Korean eatery specializing in Dakbal (spicy chicken feet), a famous local drinking snack. Their most popular menu item is the fiery Boneless Spicy Chicken Feet, which is often served alongside Jumeokbap (rice balls) and soft Gyeranjjim (steamed egg) to balance the intense heat. It’s an ideal place to experience genuine Korean late-night Hof (drinking place) cul

spots.name: Liquor Burger
spots.summary: This is Yeonsu dong's go-to for beer, burgers and events. The bar is owned by a very friendly American guy and his Korean wife. They have dart leagues, foosball, trivia nights, live music, movie nights and on-demand music videos for free. It's a small neighbourhood, so everyone knows everyone. You'll never go there without seeing a friendly face. Every couple of months they do big events in which

spots.name: Mandabok
spots.summary: This restaurant is a little way from the center of the town, and there is a parking lot in the back of the store, but only a few cars can be parked, so it is hard to park easily. If possible, it would be better to park at the public parking lot and walk. Mandabok literally recreates jjajangmyeon that was made 100 years ago when there was no chemical seasoning. This place is decorated with Chinese

spots.name: Taeyang Sikdang (Solar restaurant)
spots.summary: Taeyang Sikdang is a popular, unpretentious, and affordable local eatery in Incheon, known for its authentic, home-style Korean stews and nostalgic atmosphere. Its signature dish is the rich and deeply flavored Tuna Kimchi Jjigae (참치 김치찌개), which is served with generous portions and a variety of side dishes. This restaurant is a great spot to experience genuine Korean comfort food at a low price.

spots.name: Yeongyeong
spots.summary: One of the most popular and long-standing Chinese restaurants in Incheon Chinatown. It is famous for its unique signature dish, White Jajangmyeon (Baek Jajangmyeon), which is prepared with a clear, savory sauce instead of the traditional black bean paste. They also offer excellent standard Jajangmyeon and various dim sum options. Expect long waiting lines, especially on weekends.

spots.name: Megaton Pizza Pub
spots.summary: A specialty pizza pub near Bupyeong Culture Street, featuring handmade pizzas and a wide selection of drinks including craft beers and highballs. It is famous for its multiple large projector screens (up to 150 inches), making it an ideal spot to watch sports games (like soccer or baseball) with drinks. Pet-friendly and great for a casual late-night hangout.

spots.name: Myeongdong Boribap
spots.summary: A traditional Korean restaurant with over 40 years of history specializing in Boribap (Barley and Rice). The signature dish, Boribap Jeongshik, is served with a variety of fresh seasonal vegetables and Cheonggukjang (a robustly flavored soybean paste stew). It is an excellent choice for travelers looking for a hearty and healthy traditional Korean meal.

spots.name: Oneuldo Chwihaneun Wonsungi (The Tipsy Monkey)
spots.summary: A highly rated and atmospheric Korean pub (Hansik Jujeom) in the Guwol-dong area, known for its creative menu and cozy interior. It specializes in modern Korean dishes, such as sous vide Bossam (steamed pork belly) and various spicy stews, along with traditional Korean liquors. The place is popular for its excellent food quality and pleasant ambiance.

spots.name: Panino Gusto
spots.summary: An authentic Italian restaurant in Guwol-dong specializing in Neapolitan pizza, baked in a 485°C wood-fired oven (참나무 화덕). It offers a wide menu of pasta, risotto, and pizza (like the popular Margherita con Bufala and Gorgonzola). It is known for its excellent value, especially during lunchtime specials, making it a reliable spot for Italian dining.

spots.name: Granada Guwol
spots.summary: A well-regarded Spanish-style restaurant in the Guwol-dong area, specializing in fusion tapas, pasta, and gratins. The restaurant is popular as a date spot, offering a pleasant atmosphere and often providing free parking for up to two hours. Dishes like Gambas al Ajillo (garlic shrimp) and various pasta are highly rated.

spots.name: New York Banjeom
spots.summary: New York Banjeom is a contemporary Korean-Chinese restaurant in Incheon that puts a modern and fusion twist on traditional Chinese cuisine. While they serve high-quality classics like Jajangmyeon and Jjamppong, they are particularly known for unique fusion dishes, such as their creamy, pasta-style seafood Jjamppong.

spots.name: Moja Ondal
spots.summary: A highly popular local pub specializing in charcoal-grilled spicy chicken feet (Dakbal), known for its strong smoky flavor and fiery kick. The Boneless Chicken Feet (Mubbyeo Dakbal) are highly recommended for first-timers. This is a favorite spot for locals to pair spicy food with Soju or beer.

spots.name: Sinpo Dakgangjeong
spots.summary: Sinpo Dakgangjeong is famous nationwide for its unique sweet and spicy flavor. Unlike typical fried chicken, this dakgangjeong has a crispy texture even after being tossed in the sauce. Be warned: the basic flavor is quite spicy for some foreigners, so be ready for the kick.

spots.name: Horangi Jutack (Tiger House)
spots.summary: A cozy and atmospheric bar near Juan Station, known for its unique 'tiger house' concept. It offers a wide selection of alcoholic beverages, including craft beers, wines, and traditional Korean liquors, alongside delicious fusion dishes. Perfect for a relaxed evening out.

spots.name: Monggeuldamsuju
spots.summary: A casual Korean pub in Bupyeong known for its selection of traditional Korean liquors (Makgeolli) and premium traditional alcoholic beverages. It offers creative Korean dishes like Clam and Pork Neck Slices and Beef Brisket Doenjang Stew.

spots.name: Dr. Caligari's Cabinet
spots.summary: A popular craft beer pub known for its cozy, eclectic atmosphere and wide selection of local and regional craft beers. The venue often features a terrace and is highly recommended for 'Pimaek' (Pizza and Beer).

spots.name: DIGI Cocktail Bar
spots.summary: A popular all-you-can-drink cocktail bar in Bupyeong, known for its excellent value (unlimited cocktails at a low fixed price). Outside food is permitted, and there are dart boards available for entertainment.
